text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Nationalist MP Louis Galea files libel suits. The former social policy minister takes court action against Prime Minister Alfred Sant, a journalist and two newspapers after being linked to an alleged mafia member in Sicily.
- Maltese in London found in possession of false travellers' cheques.
- Baron John Phillips, who defused 835 bombs in Malta in the immediate post-war years, has died. The bombs were dropped by the Luftwaffe.
- General Workers' Union complains of lack of official statistics on the economy.
- Archbishop meets trade unions, employers to mark workers' day.
